== Summary ==
Icon for Chase Masterson ("Leeta") on the special guests schedule. Graphic: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999 website]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].

== Source ==

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000122135443/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Internet Archive]
* Image: [http://decipher.com/libraryimages/calendars/event/1999/mainevents/deciphercon/leetasm.gif leetasm.gif] (40×25). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000528074900/http://decipher.com/libraryimages/calendars/event/1999/mainevents/deciphercon/leetasm.gif Internet Archive]
* Identification: the schedule row it heads.
